preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must not be empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if not any(c.isdigit() for c in s) else True
postconditions.description: If the string contains no digits, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == int(str(product)[len(str(product)) // 2]) if len(str(product)) % 2 == 1 else True
postconditions.description: If the product has an odd number of digits, the output must be the middle digit.

postconditions.expression: stdout == int(str(product)[len(str(product)) // 2 - 1:len(str(product)) // 2 + 1]) if len(str(product)) % 2 == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the product has an even number of digits, the output must be the middle two digits, with leading zeros removed.
